nom: Dr. Dennis Gross Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel

segments.oily: One reviewer with combination skin reports her T-zone became less oily, allowing for more even makeup application.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin reports a less oily T-zone, smaller-looking pores and a more even skin tone.
segments.sensitive: Results vary: several reviewers with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin report only a slight tingle, calmer skin and even improved rosacea with gentle, correct use; one reviewer with rosacea initially got redness and burning until she learned to apply the pads more gently and wait longer after cleansing.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s to early 60s report smoother, firmer, more even-toned and youthful-looking skin with consistent use; one 62-year-old reviewer with significant past sun exposure did not notice real change over a single 5-day trial box.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report smaller-looking pores, softer fine lines and a firmer, more youthful look, generally within one to a few weeks of consistent use; two reviewers, however, saw little to no change in fine lines or overall appearance, with one switching to a stronger peel for more dramatic anti-aging results.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report no irritation or redness with correct, gentle use, including improvement in rosacea-related redness; others report burning or a chemical burn, and one rosacea-prone reviewer initially had redness and burning that resolved once she applied the pads more gently and waited longer after cleansing.
concerns.spots: Reports are mixed: one reviewer says the peel faded dark spots on her face, while another using it for a few months isn't sure how much it's actually helping her dark spots despite her overall skin looking and feeling better.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: several reviewers, including ones with rosacea-prone or congested skin, report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, minimized blackheads and improved acne scarring, while two others say it broke them out worse than any product they'd used.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with combination skin reports her T-zone became noticeably less oily with regular use.

aspects.libelle: Box sometimes contains fewer treatments than expected

extraits.texte: I had clear skin with minor acne scarring on cheeks. I thought I would use this to help with the acne scars and texture. It has broke my face out worse than any other face product I’ve used in my whole life. TERRIBLE!
This gave me a chemical burn on my cheeks and forehead the 2nd time I used it. Do NOT buy this product.
62 yo skin been in the sun a lot most of my life. It’s ok. Feels nice. But didn’t notice any real changes with the 5-day product. Day 1 day 5 pics. Different lighting unfortunately.

extraits.titre: Let the acids do the work - be gentle!
extraits.texte: I have used Dr. Gross's daily peel before and thought I didn't like it as it was irritating to my rosacea-prone skin with redness and burning. However, I've been doing a lot of reading and research on skincare, and now know that I was scrubbing at my skin too hard with these peel pads, and as well, applying too soon after cleansing my face--better to wait at least 10-15 minutes or more after cleansing. The important thing is to let the 'acids' do the work by gently 'swiping,' not scrubbing or rubbing too vigorously, and not too soon after cleansing. Use the first towelette - gently apply to your face (and I include my neck and chest) until the pad is feeling dry. Wait at least 2 minutes and then apply the second. I then let that sit on my face for at least 20 minutes or even more before I move on to the rest of my skincare. On exfoliation nights, I apply more gentle skincare products that are emollient. I don't use anything with Vitamin C at the same time as these (I use vit C in morning), nor do I use any retinol/retinoid on my skin on exfoliation nights. I do a 3-day skin cycling so I only use acid peels maybe 2x to 3x a week - exfoliation, retinol/retinoid, recovery, repeat. Sometimes I'll do a 4-day of exfoliate, retinol/retinoid, recovery, recovery, repeat - if my skin is feeling irritated. These are the trial size so there are only 5 treatments to this pack. I have QRxLabs pads that I use, which are a fraction of the cost and work great, and use these once in a while. L

extraits.titre: Amazing— even for fair, sensitive skin with rosacea
extraits.texte: Before my wedding, I used this product RELIGIOUSLY (every other night) for 6 months. Pics are from the day of: first with no makeup. Included the one with a veil so you know there is no airbrushing. I did extensive research before purchasing as I have very fair, VERY sensitive skin with rosacea and didn’t want to get a legit chemical peel at a dermatologist incase I had a reaction. After two treatments, there was a noticeable difference in my pores, fine lines, and skin softness and brightness. Before using these, I sometimes got a random pimple here or there, but after two weeks of using these, no pimples ever! I have never peeled flakes of skin after, but you can tell your skin is exfoliated and softer the next day. To my surprise, it even helped my rosacea. But whatever you do, DO NOT go in the sun after using them. After 4 boxes, I only had one reaction and it was entirely my fault as I was exposed to sun in the car for 4+ hours the day after using it. My face was red and a little puffy for 2 days but it was minor and also preventable had I thought about it. That being said, I will absolutely continue using this product because my skin has never looked better.

I am a huge fan of this product. The Alpha Beta Extra Strenth Daily peel makes my face feel smoother, healthier, and firmer. I like to change it up sometimes with the other Dr. Dennis Gross daily peels such as the sensitive skin, however this is my favorite! These make my skin feel so plump, but so firm and helps to prep for moisturizing. I have noticed a more even skin tone since using them! My pores even seem much smaller. Over all, my skin feels brighter especially under my eyes! I have combination skin and my T zone is less oily which allows for a more even makeup application. Also, they are absolutely perfect for travel and stay fresh in the packaging. It may seem pricey but I feel it is definitely worth the investment in keeping my skin as young as I can. I would definitely recommend The Alpha Beta Extra Strenth Daily peel but always check with your dermatologist first to be sure it is safe for you as everyone’s skin is different.

These are great for a nice gentle peel. It tingles just enough to let you know it’s working. It has helped to fade some dark spots on my face and diminish some fine lines. Keeps my skin looking youthful. I’ll be 50 this year and I think my skin looks pretty darn good!
